rendering_ambiguity_disclosure: The source declares SEPARATOR TAB; the legacy site's HTML rendering collapses tabs to space runs, so EMPTY interior cells lose their position. Rows with all 8 fields are unambiguous. For short rows the reader applies a TYPE-DECLARED rule only: a trailing token containing a decimal point cannot be the I2 dip column and is assigned to E_MODUL; a trailing INTEGER token in a 7-field row (which could be an integer-valued E in GPa OR a dip in deg) is REFUSED - both E_MODUL and DIP set NaN and the raw token preserved in a per-row quality flag. Nothing is guessed from geology. The source URL serves the file for byte-level (tab-preserving) resolution.
purpose: sixteenth catalogue entry - the catalogue's first LABORATORY ROCK STRENGTH data (TENTH kind), completing the geomechanics pair with entry 15: strength (what the rock can bear) vs overburden (what it does bear). The gate compares them live: weak foliated gneisses whose measured UCS falls BELOW the density-derived overburden at their own depth - the physical reason the KTB pilot hole developed breakouts - are counted from data, not asserted.
verified: sample count, depth/strength endpoints and extremes, type-rule assignments, refused-ambiguous count, and the live strength-vs-overburden comparison gate-pinned; source URL serves the identical table for independent re-verification
